AUM ESTATES / AN ADVISORY APPROACH

Good property advice begins before the viewing.

Different people have different constraints. The search should account for them, and the information should hold up to scrutiny.

01

Understand the person.

Budget, commute, family needs, timing and non-negotiables come first—before another list of properties.

02

Compare the complete cost.

Purchase or rental terms, recurring expenses, usable space and practical compromises—not a headline price alone.

03

Say what still needs checking.

Published information is a starting point. Specific units, documents, terms and availability need independent confirmation.
